[RLOW.7.7.1] **`log`** lowers to a terminal action of kind
`ACTION_CALL` ([RDSC.4a.8]) whose expression calls `FN_LOG`
over `(level, category, message)`. The compiler:

- Encodes the source-side level, in any case (so `info`,
  `INFO`, and `Info` are one level), as its
  `proto/log_level.proto#LogSeverity` number.
- Synthesises the `category` argument as the rule's
  name (e.g. `"trig_logger"` for a rule named
  `trig_logger`). The category has no source-level form;
  the author does not set it.
